This role


As the lead of finance for Colombia and Panama you will be reporting to the Finance Director of Latam and support the existing finance and FP&A functions of the company. You will provide support to the finance team’s efforts in managing and servicing existing debt investors.  This role requires strong analytical and forecasting skills to ensure healthy financial planning and operations control.

- Work closely with the Finance Director of Latam to support ongoing and ad-hoc analysis and modeling in support of PayJoy’s aggressive goals. The role will have straight contact with the FP&A team in the US.

- Work closely with the accounting team to gather financial information and assist with the reconciliation of Local GAAP versus US GAAP.

- Assist accounting in the audit process

- Validate the taxes paid

- Support operations in making payments to merchants and reconciling the transactions with accounting

- Problem solving and analytical skills

This role


The Business Development Retail Manager exists to lead the sustainable and profitable growth of PayJoy Mexico’s retail network, being responsible for the operational and commercial performance of PayJoy points of sale. This role is strategically important to the business because it connects the company’s commercial vision with day-to-day execution in stores. It ensures that each point of sale has the right inventory, maintains healthy credit risk metrics, effectively executes promotions and marketing campaigns, and achieves its sales targets. By managing supervisory routes and resolving operational issues in a timely manner, this position reduces variability across stores, protects business margins, and ensures a consistent customer experience throughout the entire retail network.

Responsibilities
Inventory Management Across the Retail Network: Design and oversee inventory control processes across all points of sale, coordinating closely with Supply Chain to ensure optimal stock levels that prevent both stockouts and overstock situations. Safeguard product availability for sales while minimizing excess inventory that could negatively impact operational profitability.
Maintenance of Healthy Credit and Risk Metrics: Continuously monitor First Payment Default (FPD), early delinquency, and other credit risk indicators at the store level. Identify locations exhibiting atypical performance and implement corrective action plans in collaboration with Risk teams to improve origination quality and protect the company’s portfolio.
Design and Execution of Commercial Promotions and Campaigns: Lead the development and execution of promotions and sales campaigns aimed at increasing product placement and conversion rates across points of sale. Ensure that communication materials (POP displays, signage, promotional offers, and merchandising assets) are delivered on time, properly executed in stores, and evaluated through clear ROI metrics to inform future commercial decisions.
Management of Store Visit Routes and Sales Targets: Design and manage store visitation and supervision routes across the retail network, assigning differentiated sales targets to each point of sale based on market potential and historical performance. Ensure that every store has clear objectives, defined action plans, and regular follow-up to achieve or exceed commercial goals.
Operational Issue Resolution: Address and resolve operational issues reported by stores in a timely manner, including system problems, pricing discrepancies, material shortages, and operational conflicts. Prioritize issues based on business impact and coordinate with relevant internal teams (IT, Supply Chain, Finance, and Risk) to ensure uninterrupted operations at each point of sale.
Retail Network Performance Management and Development: Conduct regular field visits to assess operational and commercial execution across stores, provide structured feedback to point-of-sale teams, identify performance gaps, and develop improvement plans that consistently raise execution standards throughout the network.
Reporting and Commercial Intelligence: Consolidate and analyze sales, inventory, risk, and KPI performance data across the retail network, producing recurring executive reports for commercial leadership. Identify trends, business opportunities, and operational risks early enough to enable proactive action before they significantly impact business results.
Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary liaison between the retail network and internal functions including Supply Chain, Marketing, Risk, Finance, and Technology. Ensure that corporate decisions are effectively translated into field execution and that operational needs from points of sale are appropriately represented and addressed within internal forums and decision-making processes.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree completed in Business Administration, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in retail management, business development, distribution network supervision, or sales management within a physical retail channel, preferably in the telecommunications, consumer goods (FMCG), or financial services industries.
Territory and Network Management: Proven experience leading or supervising multi-location retail networks (20+ points of sale), including route planning, sales target allocation, and store-level performance management.
Data Analysis and Tools: Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to interpret and analyze sales, inventory, and risk dashboards to support data-driven decision-making.

This role


Position Overview 
The Global Benefits Administrator manages, improves health, welfare, retirement, and supplemental benefit programs across 11 countries. Operating as a senior individual contributor and subject-matter expert with minimal direction, this role ensures accurate delivery, statutory compliance, vendor accountability, and a consistent global employee experience. The role addresses complex, cross-border benefits matters in close partnership with HR, Payroll, Finance, and Legal.
Key responsibilities
Administer health, welfare, retirement/pension, income protection, wellness, and supplemental benefit programs across 11 countries, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.
Serve as subject-matter expert on statutory and supplemental benefits requirements in each country; monitor regulatory changes and ensure ongoing compliance with local laws, filings, and reporting obligations.
Lead annual open enrollment and renewal cycles for each country, coordinating timelines, plan changes, system configuration, and employee communications.
Manage relationships with global and local brokers, insurers, third-party administrators, and pension providers; hold vendors accountable to service levels and support renewal negotiations and benchmarking.
Maintain accurate benefits data in the HRIS/benefits platform; audit records to ensure data integrity and payroll accuracy, and reconcile vendor invoices.
Analyze benefits costs, utilization, and market trends; support annual benefits budgeting and provide reporting and recommendations to leadership.
Act as the escalation point for complex employee benefits questions across regions and time zones, delivering clear, culturally appropriate communications and enrollment materials.
Design and implement benefits programs for new-country entries, expansions, and M&A integration; lead process-improvement, harmonization, and automation initiatives, and provide guidance to less-experienced team members.

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
+6 years proven experience in benefits administration, including significant international / multi-country experience.
In-depth understanding of statutory and supplemental benefits across multiple regions (North America, EMEA, and/or APAC); LatAm focus is a plus.
Proven experience managing brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators across borders.
Hands-on experience with an HRIS/benefits system (e.g., Rippling, Workday) and benefits administration platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with impeccable attention to detail.
Ability to manage complex projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines across time zones.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
Fluent English language proficiency is required; additional languages relevant to the covered regions are a plus.

jobs.description:
Acerca de PayJoy
 
PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible.
 
 
Acerca del rol


Garantizar la disponibilidad óptima de inventario en todos los puntos de venta a nivel nacional, liderando la planeación de compras, la relación estratégica con proveedores y el proveedor logístico, generando la visibilidad de datos que el área comercial necesita para tomar decisiones. Este rol es el puente entre la operación de inventario y la estrategia comercial, traduce comportamientos de consumo en decisiones de compra inteligentes, y transforma procesos manuales en modelos escalables y trazables. 

Responsabilidades:
- Gestión y seguimiento de obras
Dar seguimiento continuo al avance de obras de construcción, remodelación y adecuación de puntos de venta. Elaborar y mantener actualizados los cronogramas de cada proyecto, identificando desviaciones, riesgos y acciones correctivas de forma proactiva, antes de que se conviertan en retrasos.

-
Coordinación de stakeholders
Ser el punto de contacto y coordinación entre todos los actores involucrados en cada proyecto: proveedores, contratistas, arrendadores y las áreas internas de Expansión, Operaciones, Comercial, Legal y Compras. Gestionar expectativas, resolver conflictos y mantener a todos alineados al plan.

-
Control de calidad y especificaciones técnicas
Verificar que los alcances, especificaciones técnicas y estándares de calidad se cumplan en cada etapa de la obra. Realizar visitas de supervisión periódicas para validar avances, detectar incidencias y documentar planes de acción.
Requerimientos:
-
Formación académica
Licenciatura o ingeniería en Arquitectura, Ingeniería Civil, Administración de Proyectos, Ingeniería Industrial o afín. Deseable certificación en gestión de proyectos (PMP, PRINCE2 o similar).

-
Experiencia
Mínimo 3 a 5 años coordinando proyectos de construcción, remodelación o adecuación de espacios comerciales. Experiencia comprobable en manejo simultáneo de múltiples proyectos en distintas ubicaciones geográficas. Experiencia en retail, franquicias, restaurantes o cadenas con expansión de canal físico es un diferenciador importante.

Plan de salud, dental y de visión con descuento al 100% financiado por la empresa para empleados y familiares directos.

Seguro de vida.

Financiamiento de teléfono, audífonos, equipo para oficina en casa y beneficios de bienestar ( wellness ).

30 días de aguinaldo.

20 días de vacaciones pagadas.

50% de prima vacacional.

13% de fondo de ahorro.

$2,000 USD anuales de apoyo para viajes a espacios de co-working .
